2607.22334.title: Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation via Byte-Prefix Marginalization
2607.22334.paper_summary: Open-weight language models from different families exhibit complementary capabilities, motivating their consolidation into a compact student through on-policy distillation (OPD). However, full-vocabulary OPD typically assumes a shared tokenizer, while existing cross-tokenizer methods may discard teacher probability mass or assign it to student tokens with unrelated content. We introduce Byte-Prefix Marginalization (BPM), which re-expresses the teacher's next-token distribution over the student vocabulary in a shared byte space. Specifically, BPM assigns each teacher token's probability to the longest student token whose byte representation is a prefix of the teacher token's bytes, aggregates mass mapped to the same student token, and places otherwise unmatched mass in an explicit residual category. This produces a vocabulary-complete, byte-aligned, and mass-preserving target for dense OPD. The target exactly recovers the teacher-induced byte-prefix marginal when the relevant prefix does not span multiple teacher tokens (a condition satisfied at more than 99% of training positions) and uses a mass-preserving, chain-factorized lower bound otherwise. Across Qwen3-32B, GLM-Z1-9B-0414, and MiniMax-M2.7 as teachers, BPM consistently outperforms current cross-tokenizer methods on six mathematics and programming benchmarks, improving six-benchmark avg@8 by 3.7-6.6 points over the strongest baselines.
2607.22334.paper_summary_zh: 開放權重的語言模型來自不同的家族，展現出互補的能力，這促使它們通過政策內蒸餾（OPD）整合為一個緊湊的學生模型。<lb/>然而，完整詞彙的OPD通常假設共享的標記器，而現有的跨標記器方法可能會丟棄教師的概率質量或將其分配給內容無關的學生標記。<lb/>我們引入了字節前綴邊際化（BPM），它在共享的字節空間中重新表達教師的下一個標記分佈到學生詞彙上。<lb/>具體而言，BPM將每個教師標記的概率分配給其字節表示為教師標記字節前綴的最長學生標記，聚合映射到相同學生標記的質量，並將其他不匹配的質量放入一個明確的殘差類別。<lb/>這為密集OPD產生了一個詞彙完整、字節對齊且保持質量的目標。<lb/>當相關前綴不跨越多個教師標記時（這一條件在超過99%的訓練位置上得到滿足），該目標準確恢復教師引導的字節前綴邊際，否則使用保持質量的鏈式分解下界。<lb/>在Qwen3-32B、GLM-Z1-9B-0414和MiniMax-M2.7作為教師的情況下，BPM在六個數學和編程基準測試中持續超越當前的跨標記器方法，將六個基準的avg@8提高了3.7-6.6分，超過了最強的基準。
